verdict.rationale: Open-sourcing code is a fair question for a payments platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about EBANX source code, public repositories or an open license. The docs cover APIs, hosted checkout, EBANX.js and llms.txt agent guidance, none of which is readable product source under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
